video.title: Hugging Face Built a $399 Robot Duck That Ships Before Christmas
video.description:
Hugging Face + Pollen Robotics built Microduck — a $399 robot duck that ships before Christmas.

25 cm tall, under 800 g. It waddles, picks stuff up with its beak, gets back up when it falls, and yes  it roller-skates. Open-source software for reinforcement learning. Four colors: Cream, Graphite, Lavender, Sky. Pre-order now.

Would you drop $399 on a robot duck? Like and Subscribe.

Sources:
https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck
https://techcrunch.com (Microduck / Pollen / Hugging Face Aug 2026)
https://www.theverge.com

#Microduck #HuggingFace #PollenRobotics #RobotDuck #RobotechMind
